description: Summarises, for the last 24 hours, which APRS-IS gateways (iGates) with a known position received one station: the number of distinct iGates, the farthest iGate and its distance (km), and the same for the most recent transmission. Distances are great-circle kilometres between the station's position at transmit time and the iGate. For stations that ask not to be archived (APRS "!x!" marker) only the iGate count is returned: the distances come from the station's past positions.

callsign.description: Station callsign with optional SSID, for example TA4OHN-10. Case-insensitive.
